scope: Semantic DOM double, not real browser/axe or HTTP32

results.case: Measurement table has a caption, scoped headers and a keyboard-scrollable labelled region
Absent figures remain not recorded and no lean mass is derived
Historical registration timestamp does not become verified measurement date
A zero registration denominator is unavailable, not a zero adherence percentage
Completion uses actual observed counts instead of an invented four-meal denominator
An empty observed period does not invent days or registrations
Sparse observations render exactly two points without connecting or interpolating values
Two records on one date and withdrawn observations cannot produce a trend
Scope labels include only explicitly true categories and clearly indicate ongoing dates
Untrusted profile labels are text nodes, never HTML or event handlers
Retirement action is available only when the normalized server capability allows it
Error rendering uses a focusable live alert target without interpreting the message
UTC instants accept the explicit zero offset and reject normalized impossible days
A shared weight-only table does not label unshared body-fat or lean mass as unrecorded
